The season was planned to be started in February 2015.{{cite web|title=Peta Kekuatan ISL 2015 Dari 2015|url-status=dead}} [[Persib Bandung|Persib]] were the defending champions. [[Pusamania Borneo F.C.|Pusamania Borneo]] joined as the promoted teams from the [[2014 Liga Indonesia Premier Division]]. They replaced [[Persepam Madura United]], [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]], [[Persijap Jepara|Persijap]], [[Persiba Bantul]], and [[Persik Kediri|Persik]] who were relegated to the [[2015 Liga Indonesia Premier Division]]. The season would have some changes including the implementation of three different kick-off time for weekend matches, which are 15:30, 19:00 and 21:00. There would be also only two weekday matches scheduled.{{cite web|title=PT Liga Rencanakan Laga ISL 2015 Pukul 21.00 WIB|url=http://www.sportanews.com/2014/12/16/pt-liga-rencanakan-laga-isl-2015-pukul-21-00-wib/|access-date=17 December 2014|language=id|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141217031447/http://www.sportanews.com/2014/12/16/pt-liga-rencanakan-laga-isl-2015-pukul-21-00-wib/|archive-date=17 December 2014|url-status=dead}} This season was officially discontinued by [[Football Association of Indonesia|PSSI]] on 2 May 2015 due to a ban by Imam Nahrawi, Minister of Youth and Sports Affairs, against PSSI to run any football competition.{{cite web|title=Force Majeur, PSSI Hentikan Semua Kompetisi|url=http://www.ligaindonesia.co.id/index.php/read/isl/Force-Majeur-PSSI-Hentikan-Semua-Kompetisi-8267#.VUVA5fntmko|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150504225344/http://ligaindonesia.co.id/index.php/read/isl/Force-Majeur-PSSI-Hentikan-Semua-Kompetisi-8267#.VUVA5fntmko|url-status=dead|archive-date=4 May 2015|access-date=2 May 2015|language=id}} ==Teams== Eighteen teams competed in the league – the 17 teams from the previous season and the one team promoted from the [[2015 Liga Indonesia Premier Division|Premier Division]]. The new teams this season were [[Pusamania Borneo F.C.|Pusamania Borneo]] and [[Persiwa Wamena|Persiwa]], who replaced [[Persepam Madura United]], [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]], [[Persijap Jepara|Persijap]], and [[Persiba Bantul]].
